SELECT
    p.PromotionName,
    p.PromotionCategory,
    p.DiscountPercent,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity)                                                        AS total_units_sold,
    countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber)                                           AS total_orders,
    round(sum(f.SalesQuantity) / nullif(countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_order,
    round(sum(f.SalesAmount), 2)                                                AS total_sales_amount,
    round(sum(f.DiscountAmount), 2)                                             AS total_discount_given
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE f.PromotionKey != 1          -- exclude "No Discount" baseline
  AND p.DiscountPercent IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    p.PromotionName,
    p.PromotionCategory,
    p.DiscountPercent
ORDER BY p.DiscountPercent ASC
